declarations.type:
∀ (requirement : SearchRouteCost.RouteRequirement) (budget : SearchRouteDAG.GraphRouteBudget)
  (candidate : SearchRouteDAG.GraphCandidate),
  SearchRouteDAG.graphFeasibleB requirement budget candidate = true →
    ∃ snapshot wrapped,
      wrapped.graphCandidate = candidate ∧
        SearchRouteEvidenceGraphRouter.ReceiptBound snapshot wrapped ∧
          SearchRouteDAG.graphFeasibleB requirement budget wrapped.graphCandidate = true ∧
            ¬SearchRouteEvidenceGraphRouter.RuntimeReady wrapped
